acceptance.given: The frozen Package A requirements define an exact production allowlist consisting of the FR-1 deliverables and scripts/sc/skill_quality_examples.py.

oracle.expected: A changed-path review confirms every production modification is within the exact frozen allowlist and no forbidden repository path is modified.
forbidden: A production modification outside the frozen allowlist.
A test, fixture, evidence, or directory path treated as a production owner.
oracle.observable: The changed production-path manifest and implementation binding enumerate only allowlisted production files.

acceptance.then: The structural scope check evaluates the implementation binding and changed production-path manifest against the frozen allowlist and forbidden-path exclusions.
acceptance.when: During structural validation after candidate production changes are selected and before implementation acceptance.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A scope-boundary validation selector inspects the changed production-path manifest and fails when any production path is outside the frozen FR-1 allowlist or enters a forbidden path.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or enforce structural validation that production changes remain within the exact frozen Package A allowlist.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime state or database schema changes; rollback removes the validator scope enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Production ownership moves from an unverified declared allowlist to a validated allowlist-constrained change set.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation succeeds only when every production change path belongs to the exact frozen allowlist and no forbidden path is modified.
